in_marathi.name: Mihika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mihika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Mihika is derived from the word 'mihika' which means 'younger sister'. It is also the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology, Mihika, who is believed to protect infants and children. The name is rich in symbolism and signifies love, care, and protection.
